app.title: Whity Agent
connections.title: Workspaces
connections.intro: Connect a Whity workspace. Your AI tools then reach it through this app, with your own access.
connections.signingIn: Finish signing in in your browser…
errors.invalidAddress: Enter a workspace address, such as app.whity.dev.
errors.noSignIn: This workspace doesn't offer sign-in for apps yet.
errors.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled in the browser.
errors.timedOut: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
errors.keychain: Your computer's keychain isn't available, so this sign-in lasts until you close the app.
tools.title: Your AI tools
tools.intro: Connect the AI tools on this computer to a workspace. Each tool signs in to Whity itself; no password or token is written into its files.
tools.none: No AI tools found on this computer.
tools.signInFirst: Sign in to a workspace first.
review.title: Review before connecting {tool}
review.command: Whity Agent will run this command, from {tool} itself:
review.file: Whity Agent will change {path}. A backup is kept, and you can put it back.
review.nothing: {tool} is already connected to this workspace.
review.signIn: {tool} asks you to sign in to Whity the first time it uses the workspace.
review.viaBridge: {tool} will run Whity Agent to reach the workspace. Your sign-in stays in your computer's keychain, not in this file.
